symbols.name: first contraction
symbols.meaning: A linear map from length-$s$ vectors to length-$t$ vectors, the first of the two contractions in the identity.
symbols.quote: Here $A$ is a linear map from length-$s$ to length-$t$ vectors.

symbols.name: second contraction
symbols.meaning: A linear map from length-$t$ vectors to length-$s$ vectors, the second of the two contractions in the identity.
symbols.quote: $B_0$ is a linear map from length-$t$ to length-$s$ vectors.

relations.quote: It is obtained by inverting the [Gaussian resampling](gaussian-resampling.md) identity, which keeps both permutations.
The two maps are linear contractions, bounded in the [operator norm](operator-norm.md) by one, meaning each sends a vector to one of norm at most its input norm.
